description: Facilities, hostel, and transport related knowledge for the MERI Admission Voice Agent.

examples: Tell me about the campus facilities.
faqs.answer: MERI offers smart classrooms, a well-equipped library, computer labs, sports and fitness facilities, and a modern campus environment.
MERI has a well-stocked library supporting academic and reference material for students.
MERI has computer labs including an Apple Certified Computer Lab to support technology-based learning.
Classrooms at MERI are smart, LCD-enabled spaces designed for interactive learning.
MERI promotes a holistic sports and fitness culture as part of campus life.

examples: Is there a hostel on campus?
faqs.answer: For the latest information on hostel availability and accommodation options, please connect with the admissions team.

examples: Do you have a college bus?
faqs.answer: For the latest information on transport availability and routes, please connect with the admissions team.
For details on WiFi and internet facilities on campus, please connect with the admissions team.

examples: Do you have any special labs?
Any GIS or space studies labs?
faqs.answer: MERI has special facilities such as a Department of Space Studies, a GIS lab, and audio-video labs.
